claim: In the HWA 10.2.8 laboratory, the nested twsinst invocation made by serverinst with -agent both rejected equal -thiscpu and -displayname values with AWSFAB164E. This is an observed constraint of that invocation; it is not evidence of a universal rule that the parameters must always differ.
supporting_quote: AWSFAB164E The values specified for "-thiscpu" and "-displayname" cannot be the same.
notes: Official references distinguish thiscpu as the installation workstation and displayname as the dynamic-agent name. The official agent reference also states that thiscpu cannot equal the master workstation name: https://help.hcl-software.com/workloadautomation/v1028/distr/src_pi/awspiagentparams.html
